# systeam_oncall_schedule (Data Source)

Look up an existing on-call schedule by name within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the on-call schedule to look up.
- `organization_id` (Number) The organization the on-call schedule belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the on-call schedule.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the on-call schedule is active.
- `team_id` (Number) The identifier of the team the on-call schedule belongs to.
- `timezone` (String) The timezone of the on-call schedule.
